# CityClick (cityclick.com) — Full Primary-Source Methodology & API Reference

## 1. Platform Scope & Crawl Shield Governance
CityClick publishes US municipal guides built strictly from traceable federal and state primary datasets for visitors, relocating households, and local business founders.
- Prime Directive: A blank or omitted block is always chosen over an estimated, defaulted, or unverified figure.
- Certified Indexable Flagship Guides (25 cities passing primary-source audit and rendered HTML quality checks):
  1. Austin, Texas: https://cityclick.com/tx/austin/
  2. Nashville, Tennessee: https://cityclick.com/tn/nashville/
  3. Hot Springs, Arkansas: https://cityclick.com/ar/hot-springs/
  4. Hot Springs Village, Arkansas: https://cityclick.com/ar/hot-springs-village/
  5. Boise, Idaho: https://cityclick.com/id/boise/
  6. Tampa, Florida: https://cityclick.com/fl/tampa/
  7. Scottsdale, Arizona: https://cityclick.com/az/scottsdale/

- Remaining Preview Catalog: ~1,476 additional US municipal entries carry `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">` and remain excluded from `sitemap.xml` until verified from primary sources.
- Canonical URL Rule: All HTML page routes use a trailing slash (e.g., `https://cityclick.com/tx/austin/`, `https://cityclick.com/methodology/`). API routes (`/api/v1/...`) and static asset files (`.json`, `.txt`, `.pdf`) do not use a trailing slash.

## 2. Primary Federal & State Data Sources

### 2.1 Demographics, Housing & Effective Property Tax
- U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2023 5-Year Table-Based Summary File (`ACS-2023-5YR`):
  - `B01003`: Total resident population (used directly for CDPs not covered by `SUB-EST2023`)
  - `B19013`: Median household income (USD)
  - `B19301`: Per-capita income (USD)
  - `B01002`: Median resident age (years)
  - `B25077`: Median value of owner-occupied housing units (USD)
  - `B25064`: Median gross monthly residential rent (USD)
  - `B25103`: Median annual real estate taxes paid on owner-occupied units (USD)
  - Effective Property Tax Rate (%): `round((B25103 / B25077) * 100, 2)`
- U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program (`SUB-EST2023`, `SUMLEV == 162`):
  - Total population as of July 1, 2023 (`POPESTIMATE2023`)
  - Population change percentage from April 1, 2020 estimates base (`ESTIMATESBASE2020`) to July 1, 2023:
    `popChange2020to2023Pct = round((POPESTIMATE2023 / ESTIMATESBASE2020 - 1) * 100, 1)`

### 2.2 Small-Business NAICS Trade Density (Census ZBP + ZCTA)
- Source: U.S. Census Bureau 2022 ZIP Code Business Patterns (`zbp22detail.zip`) paired with ACS 2023 5-Year ZCTA resident population (`860Z200US{zip}`).
- Same-Universe Calculation:
  For all USPS ZIP codes assigned to the city in ZBP that have positive ACS ZCTA population (`ZCTA_Pop`), employer establishments `E` for a 6-digit NAICS code are summed across those exact ZIP codes:
  - `per10kResidents = (E / ZCTA_Pop) * 10000`
  - `usAvgPer10k = (US_Total_ZBP_Establishments / US_ACS_Population) * 10000`
  - `saturationIndex = round((per10kResidents / usAvgPer10k) * 100)`
- Status Thresholds (`100` = US national ZBP benchmark):
  - `saturationIndex < 80`: `underserved`
  - `80 <= saturationIndex <= 120`: `balanced`
  - `saturationIndex > 120`: `saturated`
- Noise Filter: Any NAICS category with `usAvgPer10k < 0.3` or expected city establishments `(usAvgPer10k * ZCTA_Pop / 10000) < 2.0` is omitted rather than extrapolated.

### 2.4 Retail Sales Tax, Climate, Geography & Civic Infrastructure
- Retail Sales Tax: Official state Department of Revenue and Comptroller rate publications stored in `sources/sales-tax.json` (`stateTaxRate`, `localTaxRate`, `combinedSalesTaxRate`, `sourceUrl`, `verifiedAt`).
- Terrain Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP Point Query Service) queried at the U.S. Census 2023 Gazetteer municipal internal point.
- Climate Averages: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis, `2015-01-01` to `2024-12-31`), reporting mean July daily maximum (`peakSummerHighF`), mean January daily minimum (`winterLowF`), and mean annual precipitation (`annualRainfallInches`).
- Drinking Water: U.S. EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS Envirofacts), active Community Water Systems (`PWS_TYPE_CODE = CWS`, `PWS_ACTIVITY_CODE = A`).
- Commercial Airports: OurAirports (`scheduled_service == "yes"`), straight-line Haversine distance in miles from the Census 2023 Gazetteer internal point.
- Emergency Hospitals: CMS Care Compare Hospital General Information (`xubh-q36u`) filtered to `emergency_services == "Yes"` — listed objectively with CMS Facility IDs and zero trauma-level or ranking claims.
- Higher Education, EV Charging & Parks: U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard, U.S. Dept. of Energy / NREL AFDC public EV charging stations, and National Park Service (NPS) API.

## 3. Retail Lease Breakeven Calculator Formulas (`/tools/lease-calculator/`)
CityClick does not publish guessed commercial market rents. Users enter their own quoted base rent and NNN/CAM pass-throughs:
- `MonthlyOccupancyCost = (SqFt * (QuotedBaseRentSqFtYr + QuotedNnnCamSqFtYr)) / 12`
- `MonthlyLaborCost = HourlyWage * StaffHoursPerWeek * 4.3482 * 1.18` (includes 18% employer payroll tax & benefits burden)
- `MonthlyFixedCost = MonthlyOccupancyCost + MonthlyLaborCost + MonthlyOverhead`
- `NetTicketExTax = AvgGrossTicket / (1 + CombinedSalesTaxRate)`
- `ContributionMarginPerCustomer = NetTicketExTax * (1 - CogsPct)`
- `MonthlyCustomersNeeded = ceil(MonthlyFixedCost / ContributionMarginPerCustomer)`
- `DailyCustomersNeeded = ceil(MonthlyCustomersNeeded / 30.4375)`
- `MonthlyNetRevenueNeeded = MonthlyFixedCost / (1 - CogsPct)`

## 4. Public REST API (`GET /api/v1/cities/{state}/{city}`)
Open public read access (no API key required). Verified response for `GET https://cityclick.com/api/v1/cities/tx/austin`:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "slug": "tx/austin",
    "name": "Austin",
    "state": "Texas",
    "stateCode": "tx",
    "population": 979882,
    "medianHouseholdIncome": 91461,
    "popChange2020to2023Pct": 1.9,
    "medianHomeValue": 512700,
    "medianGrossRent": 1655,
    "effectivePropertyTaxRatePct": 1.52,
    "source": "US Census Bureau ACS 2023 5-year; Population Estimates 2023",
    "certified": true,
    "combinedSalesTax": 0.0825,
    "timeZone": "CT",
    "topUnderservedTrades": []
  }
}
```
